featured_reviews.name: Harshika Jhaveri
featured_reviews.review_text: My experience at Eva diagnostics was excellent from Rohini guiding which test package I needed based on the requirements from the doctor to Vinita welcoming me and going through each tests and process with me. The lab technicians, doctors and the support staff were very kind and helpful. They patiently answered any queries I had and guided me properly. The receptionist Yamini was very nice and welcomed me with a smile, which helped in reducing my anxiety when I entered the center. You need a good supportive environment when you go for medical tests because health anxiety (especially post Covid) is usually high and having such a calm space where you don't feel rushed and people are supportive and patient with you really helps. I had that experience at Eva diagnostics and I would definitely recommend Eva diagnostics to others. Thanks a ton to everyone at Eva for making my journey smoother!

featured_reviews.name: Janki Miles
featured_reviews.review_text: Excellent visit to Eva healthcare. It ticked all the boxes in terms of the diagnostic priorities for me. From the moment of arrival to departure, there was a personal touch. Vanita, at reception provided exceptional customer service and she was lovely and friendly. A real asset to the company. Through my 3-4 hours stay, I dealt with trained professionals who put me at ease even during uncomfortable tests and were knowledgeable about their subject matter. The equipment was modern and clean, the space was calm, quiet and privacy was maintained at all times. Timings were well managed so I didn’t queue for anything. A very good experience which I would be happy to recommend to friends and family. The only reason for not giving 5 stars is that I think it could do with a bit of a facelift - it’s very spacious but could brighter. Rohini also took time to take my personal feedback, which showed they take customer experience seriously. I will definitely book again.

featured_reviews.name: Pinky Wadekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had an appointment for my medical test (Eva Wellness Silver) sponsored by my employer.
Visited here at 8 AM and I was greeted by very humble reception staff.
Post which I was guided to the cabins where my tests would be conducted and at every stage I was assisted by their staff members.
It was really helpful when they were explaining me the steps and information about why the particular test is being conducted.
This is a very good way to make a layman understand the benefits of such tests.
Overall am delighted and would recommend anyone who visits here to experience the treatment and support from them.

featured_reviews.name: Shruti Prashant Joshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
On Sunday, 18th January, I decided to visit EVA in Bangalore, part of NM Medical, located opposite Leela Palace.

From the moment I walked in, I was greeted by warm, welcoming faces who promptly confirmed my details and the tests I had opted for. There was no waiting at all—I was seamlessly guided to my blood tests. The experience was surprisingly comfortable; the lady drawing my blood kept me engaged in a pleasant conversation, frequently checking if I was okay. Thanks to her calm and caring approach, I didn’t even realise when five vials were drawn—without a moment of anxiety.

Post this, I was guided for my sonography (abdomen and pelvic area) and mammography. The doctor was extremely gentle, patient, and explained things clearly, which instantly put me at ease.

Once the tests were done, I was escorted to a beautifully set-up breakfast area within the lab. Never before have I experienced a healthy, thoughtfully curated breakfast at a diagnostic centre. This was also when I had a conversation with the Head of the Centre, who genuinely wanted to understand how my experience had been so far.

The final test was the mammogram—something I had always been apprehensive about. However, my experience at EVA completely changed that perception. The technician was exceptionally gentle, constantly checking on my comfort and ensuring there was no distress. That long-standing fear is now truly gone.

Overall, it was a wonderful, seamless experience—completely unlike the usual diagnostic centres where waiting, confusion, and follow-ups are the norm. EVA has truly redefined what a healthcare experience can feel like.

featured_reviews.name: HB
featured_reviews.review_text: As an NRI, living in a country that doesn't provide any preventive care or diagnostics, coming to NM Eva has been a great find. Their services are top notch, and their tests are very comprehensive. Right from full profile blood tests, to ECGs and Ultrasounds, to Bone density and fat analysis (both crucial for women), this place is a one stop shop for all diagnostic women care. What's even better is their impeccable service and hygiene, economical packages, and the safety of being an all women centre makes this a great choice for women looking for diagnostic care. Their centre is stress free and a far cry from the stress and chaos of hospitals. 100% recommended, especially if you live outside India and are unable to find medical professionals who are interested in your preventive care woes. Thank you Rohini and Vanita and all the lovely staff their for their attention and care.

featured_reviews.review_text:
*K N Diagnostic - Truly Excellent Service*

My experience at K N Diagnostic was outstanding from start to finish. The staff is professional, courteous, and genuinely caring. Booking an appointment was easy, and I had almost no waiting time. The reception team explained the procedures clearly and answered all my questions patiently.

The lab and diagnostic center is spotlessly clean and well maintained, which immediately builds confidence. The technicians are highly skilled and handled my tests with great care. They made sure I was comfortable throughout the process.

Reports were delivered promptly and were accurate, detailed, and easy to understand. The doctors on panel also took time to explain the results without rushing, which I really appreciated.

Pricing is transparent with no hidden charges, and the rates are very reasonable for the quality of service provided. The overall environment is calm and hygienic, making the whole experience stress-free.

I would highly recommend K N Diagnostic to anyone looking for reliable, fast, and compassionate diagnostic services. They truly maintain 5-star standards in healthcare diagnostics. I will definitely return for any future tests and will refer my family and friends as well.
